skill.name: notion-automation
skill.description: Automate Notion pages, databases, blocks, comments, and users through the Rube MCP Notion toolkit.
skill.summary: Guide reliable Notion workflows through current Rube MCP tool schemas.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The apparent shell execution and reconnaissance findings are Markdown and Notion workflow documentation, so they are false positives. The external Rube MCP endpoint is a real network dependency. Third-party OAuth mediation and unguarded destructive Notion actions require clear consent and confirmation controls.

remediation.issue: Notion access is delegated through a third-party MCP service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the data path, require users to verify the MCP domain, and request the minimum Notion permissions before authentication.

remediation.issue: Destructive Notion operations can run without explicit confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require a target summary, impact preview, and user confirmation before archive, replace, delete, or schema-change operations.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Notion connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `notion`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `NOTION_SEARCH_NOTION_PAGE` - Find parent page or existing page [Prerequisite]
2. `NOTION_CREATE_NOTION_PAGE` - Create a new page under a parent [Optional]
4. `NOTION_UPDATE_PAGE` - Update page properties, title, icon, cover [Optional]
- `properties`: Page property values matching parent schema
- `filter`: Filter object matching Notion filter syntax
- `properties`: Property values matching database schema for inserts/updates
1. `NOTION_FETCH_BLOCK_CONTENTS` - Read child blocks of a page [Required]
- Use `content_blocks` parameter, NOT `child_blocks` -- the latter fails validation
- `parent_id`: Parent page ID for new databases
- `properties`: Property definitions with types and options
3. `NOTION_CREATE_COMMENT` - Add a comment to a page [Optional]
- `rich_text`: Comment content as rich text array
- Response data may be nested under `data_preview` or `data.results`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- 404 object_not_found usually means wrong database_id or the database is not shared with the integr

content.user_title: Automate Notion Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Manual Notion updates are repetitive and error-prone. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows for pages, databases, blocks, comments, and users.
actual_capabilities: Searches for Notion pages and databases before resolving object identifiers.
Creates, retrieves, updates, duplicates, and archives Notion pages.
Queries databases with filters, sorting, and cursor-based pagination.
Inserts and updates database rows after inspecting the current schema.
Reads, appends, replaces, and removes page content blocks.
Lists workspace users and creates or retrieves page comments.
limitations: Requires a configured Rube MCP server and an active Notion OAuth connection.
Can access only pages and databases shared with the connected Notion integration.
Relies on current Rube MCP tool schemas, which may change after publication.
Destructive writes need user confirmation because the source workflow does not require it.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Trackers
use_cases.description: Query project databases, add records, and update statuses after validating each property against the current schema.

use_cases.title: Publish Structured Notes
use_cases.description: Create pages and append organized content blocks beneath the correct parent page.

use_cases.title: Review Workspace Activity
use_cases.description: Retrieve page metadata, content, users, and comments for workspace reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Notion Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Notion page named [page name]. Search all result pages and report matching titles and parent locations. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Project Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the parent page named [parent]. Create a child page titled [title] with these sections: [sections]. Confirm the resolved parent before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Update Database Records
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the [database] schema. Find records matching [criteria], preview proposed changes to [properties], and update only after I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Synchronize a Notion Tracker
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [database], paginate every result, and compare records with [requirements]. Propose inserts, updates, and schema changes separately. Execute only approved actions.

output_examples.input: Find the Roadmap database and show active projects.
output: Resolved Roadmap to the shared product workspace database.
Found 12 active projects across two result pages.
Returned project names, owners, statuses, and due dates without modifying records.

output_examples.input: Create a weekly review page under Team Operations.
output_examples.output: Resolved Team Operations as the parent and prepared a Weekly Review page with priorities, decisions, risks, and next steps.
Located the page and presented its title and parent location. The archive action is waiting for explicit confirmation.

best_practices: Search current Rube MCP tools before each workflow because schemas can change.
Resolve and verify page or database identifiers before any write operation.
Preview destructive changes and require explicit user confirmation before execution.
anti_patterns: Do not assume search results are complete without processing every pagination cursor.
Do not write database properties before fetching and validating the current schema.
Do not archive, replace, delete, or change schemas from an ambiguous request.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP configured in the client and an active Notion connection established through OAuth.

faq.question: Does the skill need a separate Notion API key?
faq.answer: No separate API key is described. Authentication uses the connection flow returned by Rube MCP.

faq.question: Why can the skill not find a page?
faq.answer: The page may have a different title, remain unshared with the integration, or appear on a later search page.

faq.question: Can it modify database schemas?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create databases and add or modify properties, but changing an existing property type requires migration.

faq.question: Can it permanently delete Notion content?
faq.answer: The documented archive and delete operations use Notion archival behavior. They should still require confirmation because content becomes unavailable.

faq.question: How does it avoid incomplete database results?
faq.answer: It checks the pagination status and continues with each returned cursor until no more results remain.
